news_analysis.headline_hook: Retired Judge Loses ₹2.5 Crore in Digital Arrest Scam, Accused Held in
news_analysis.breaking_event_summary: A retired judge was defrauded of ₹2.5 crore in a digital arrest cyber fraud, following which law enforcement arrested a suspect in Kerala.
news_analysis.retail_illusion: Many retail bank account holders assume only financially unsophisticated or digitally illiterate individuals fall prey to cyber fraud.
news_analysis.institutional_reality: Indian regulatory and investigative agencies do not conduct arrests or demand fund transfers via video calls, as the concept of a 'digital arrest' has no legal standing under Indian law.
news_analysis.actionable_retail_rule: Terminate any unexpected video or audio call where an alleged authority demands an immediate money transfer to avoid arrest, and verify the claim independently through official police or bank channels.

deck.caption: Retired judge or common investor—yaru irundhalum indha online scam trap-la vizha mudiyum! Digital arrest-nu sonna udane bayandhu panam transfer pannidadhinga. Indha fraud-la enna nadanthuchu? Neenga epdi safe irukalam? Unga experience-la idhupolana scam calls ungalukku vandhurukka?

slides.title: Retired judge-ke vandha periya shock! ₹2.5 Crore loss in 'Digital Arrest' scam!
Enna nadanthuchu indha case-la?
slides.card_text: Kerala-la indha scam-kaga accused-ah arrest pannirukanga. Video call panni, thappu pannitinga nu bayamuruthi ivlo periya amount-ah thorathi vangirukanga.

comparison_data.myth: Police-um, investigative agencies-um video call panni arrest pannuvanga, illana panam transfer panna sollvanga.
comparison_data.reality: Indian law-la 'digital arrest' nu edhumeh kedaiyathu! Yaarum video call-la vandhu ind mari panam kekka mudiyaadhu.

slides.title: Smart aanavangalum yen sikkaranga?
slides.card_text: Innoruvaruku romba digital literacy irukalam, aana uniform, official-a pesura tone parthu panic aagiruvanga. Andha bayame ivangaloda periya weapon!

checklist_data.text: Video call-la varuvanuga, police uniform potrupanuga.
Case podurom, immediate-a panam transfer pannu nu emergency katruvanuga.
Nerula police station-ku varra solli notice kudutha mattumey sandhegapaduga.

slides.title: Investigation eppo serious aachu?
slides.card_text: Police complaint kudutha udane, cyber cell track panni Kerala-la accused-ah pudichitanga. Action fast-a irundhalum, lost amount-ah recover panradhu romba kashtam.

slides.title: Golden Rule to Stay Safe
slides.card_text: Evlo periya official-nu sonnalum, unexpected video/audio call-ah cut pannunga. Neengale direct-ah official bank illana police channel-ku poi verify pannunga.

slides.title: Share pannunga, safe-ah irunga!
slides.cta_detail: Indha scam trick-ah unga family-kku solli kudunga. Unexpected-a oru call vandha udane cut panni verify panra habit-ah follow pannunga. Save this post!
